g.text: Source: NCHS NHANES 2021-2023, exam weights; design-based 95% CIs.
Obesity (BMI 30 or more) is highest at ages 40 to 59 (up to 47.5% of women), and diagnosed
diabetes rises to 20.4% to 24.2% at 65 and older
